meta.name: ppt-roadshow-generator
meta.description: PPT 路演视频全流程生成器，支持品牌风格学习、智能配音、音效音乐、字幕和一键视频合成。可一次性生成 15-100 页风格统一的完整路演视频。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将PPT一键转化为带配音和字幕的路演视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把PPT快速变成专业路演视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn your PPT into a professional roadshow video with voiceover and subtitles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly convert PPT into a professional roadshow video

howto.what: 制作路演视频时，Claude 会把你的文档拆成 15-100 页内容，依次完成规划、视觉设计、演讲稿、配音、音效、音乐、字幕和转场，最终合成完整视频。它还能学习你提供的品牌风格样例并保持页面统一。
howto.when: 当你说要制作路演视频、产品发布演示、公司介绍视频等时触发；也可以在你提供网页设计风格、PPT 内容或现成图片后继续加工。

say.text: 帮我把这份产品说明做成 15 页的路演视频
say.note: Claude 会启动十角色流程，产出含配音、字幕的完整视频。

say.text: 先学一下这个 PPT 的品牌风格，再生成视频
say.note: 它会保存品牌风格配置并应用到所有页面。

say.text: 把这份网页设计风格导入，生成路演视频
say.note: 它会导入 brand_style.json 并生成视频。

howto.what_en: When creating a roadshow video, Claude turns your document into 15-100 pages: planning, visual design, narration, voiceover, sound, music, subtitles, transitions, then composes the final video. It can learn your brand style from samples for consistency.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a roadshow video, product launch demo, or company intro video; also when you provide a web design style, PPT content, or existing images to process further.

say_en.text: Turn this product brief into a 15-page roadshow video.
say_en.note: Claude starts the full pipeline and outputs a video.

say_en.text: Learn the brand style from this PPT first, then generate the video.
say_en.note: It saves the style and applies it to pages.

say_en.text: Import this web design style and generate a roadshow video.
say_en.note: It imports brand_style.json and creates the video.
